title: VistA/MUMPS Developer
description:
Description
About Our Team
Our employees thrive in a culture that is fast-paced, collaborative, and ego-free, where innovation and teamwork are encouraged at every level. We provide Federal agencies with immediate access to highly skilled professionals who understand complex mission challenges and deliver efficient, scalable solutions. By continuously investing in talent, technology, and specialized capabilities, we maintain expert teams prepared to support evolving Federal missions through tailored technical solutions and modern service delivery approaches.
We value diverse perspectives and strive to attract talent from all backgrounds. We are seeking professionals who are passionate about technology, mission success, and solving complex operational challenges with creativity and purpose. If you enjoy expanding your technical expertise while supporting impactful Federal initiatives, you will thrive within our organization. Veterans and military spouses are strongly encouraged to apply and bring their valuable experience to our team.
About the Role
Our company is seeking a highly skilled MUMPS/CACHE developer to join our fast-growing IT-project based consulting business. Our team is working with a large federal agency to modernize all aspects of their health services application portfolio and we need top notch technical skills to get it done! We need a well-rounded team member with a background in MUMPS/CACHE development and integration that can work within an Agile team environment to maintain and enhance VistA applications.
We're seeking talented and bright team players who are passionate about technology and want to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, and ego-free culture while applying a creative approach to problem-solving. Team members who like to grow their skill sets while solving challenging, real world business problems thrive on our team. By joining our team, you’ll become a part of a fun and diverse team of talented and creative people who share the goal of using the latest technology to solve business challenges.
The MUMPS/CACHE developer will collaborate with a mix of technical experts and architects, business/product owners, business analysts, technical writers, testers, and scrum masters in a DevSecOps focused, Agile-Scrum environment. Our team members must have a proactive nature. We're looking for team members who are eager to problem solve, collaborate with business and technical team members, willing to learn, and always show great initiative in their daily pursuits.
Responsibilities

• Provide technical expertise in MUMPS/Cache development, integration, and deployment.

• Support HL7 messaging and healthcare data management initiatives.

• Work within an Agile Scrum and DevSecOps environment.

• Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software solutions.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements and system architecture.

• Write clean, efficient, and maintainable MUMPS code.

• Participate in backlog refinement, estimation, and sprint activities.

TAG:
TAG: INDMJC
Requirements
Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 2-5 years of experience with MUMPS/Cache software development.

• Experience with HL7 messaging development and integration.

• Knowledge of software development, web applications, APIs, and architectural patterns.

• Strong problem-solving, communication, and client-facing skills.

• Ability to understand user requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

• Ability to work remotely.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Agile frameworks and regression testing.

• Knowledge of VA VistA systems and TRM compliance.

• Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility requirements.

• SAFe certification.

title: Benelux (Senior) Risk and Controls Analyst
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Als WPP Media Benelux (Sr) Risk and Controls Analyst ben je een cruciale schakel binnen het team. Je ondersteunt de Risk & Controls Lead bij het continu verbeteren van de interne beheersingsomgeving van de organisatie. Deze rol is sterk operationeel gericht: de nadruk ligt op de dagelijkse uitvoering en het onderhoud van interne beheersmaatregelen (internal controls), compliance-activiteiten en het waarborgen van de naleving van het beleid binnen WPP Media Benelux.

Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan het verankeren van een cultuur van ethiek en integriteit. Dit doe je door beheersmaatregelen nauwkeurig te beschrijven, de werking ervan actief te valideren en te fungeren als primair aanspreekpunt voor interne vragen over SOx en intern beleid. Met jouw nauwkeurige, analytische en proactieve werkwijze bied je essentiële ondersteuning bij het bouwen en onderhouden van een sterk Risk & Control framework binnen dynamisch medialandschap.

Je maakt deel uit van het internationale Risk & Controls team en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de WPP Media Benelux Risk & Controls Lead. Je hoofddoel is het bieden van hands-on ondersteuning gedurende de gehele risicocyclus: van het bijhouden en valideren van documentatie tot het uitvoeren van controlemonitoring, auditcoördinatie en het ondersteunen van herstelacties (remediation). Je bent leergierig, detailgericht en krijgt energie van het vertalen van complexe vereisten naar praktische, goed uitgevoerde controle-activiteiten om het beheersingslandschap van WPP Media BeNeLux.

Wat ga je doen?

• Interne controle-documentatie & onderhoud : Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het onderhouden en regelmatig bijwerken van controlebeschrijvingen, narratives en stroomschema's (flowcharts) voor financiële, operationele en compliance-beheersmaatregelen binnen WPP Media BeNeLux.

• Je zorgt ervoor dat alle documentatie strikt aansluit bij het overkoepelende WPP Internal Control Framework en consistent voldoet aan de vereiste standaarden voor bewijsvoering. Daarnaast ondersteun je de integratie van controls in nieuwe of gewijzigde bedrijfsprocessen en systemen. Je maakt hierbij intensief gebruik van de WPP Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) tool (Impero).

• Controlemonitoring & validatie: Als onderdeel van de second line of defence voer je kwaliteitsreviews en controlemonitoringsprogramma's uit. Je valideert actief de werking van interne beheersmaatregelen door bewijsmateriaal te verzamelen en te beoordelen Ook ondersteun je bij de coördinatie en eerste beoordeling van self-certifications en bespreek je eventuele tekortkomingen met de Risk & Controls Lead om tot een gedegen oplossing te komen.

• SOx & beleidsondersteuning: Je fungeert als het centrale aanspreekpunt binnen de Benelux voor dagelijkse vragen over Sarbanes-Oxley (SOx) compliance en het interne beleid van WPP en WPP Media. Je geeft heldere en beknopte adviezen aan stakeholders en ondersteunt bij de communicatie over beleidswijzigingen en nieuwe controlevereisten binnen de organisatie.

title: General Counsel (remote)
description:
We are hiring a  General Counsel , reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.

This is a unique opportunity for an exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.

Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will own Canonical's legal, regulatory and governance posture and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.

In our selection process, we prioritize intellect and judgement alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.

Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA time zones.

The role entails

• Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting it's structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas.

• Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly.

• Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.

• Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.

• Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings.

• Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.

• Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.

• Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.

• Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.

• Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.

What we are looking for in you

• An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.

• A degree in law, or equivalent, and an active licence to practice in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.

• Substantial senior in-house experience in a global technology or software business.

• Proven experience leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.

• A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.

• Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.

As a senior creative leader, you’ll provide clear direction to creative teams, mentor and develop talent, build strong client relationships, and help raise the creative bar across Purplemoon. Champion innovation by exploring emerging technologies, AI capabilities, new platforms, and creative trends that can elevate the work.

description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. description:
Join the ASI Partners family as a legacy person you can come back to or refer others to as a government career source and interview for a direct-hire REMOTE opportunity with a major subcontractor on a long-term contract (potential to 2029) serving a massive IT modernization effort at the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).

We are looking for a fully-certified Salesforce Quality Assurance guru with at least 7 years ideally doing QA with the government Cloud working on Salesforce/Mulesoft, Agile CI/CD, Security model, Apex, LWC, etc.

Having a Public Trust clearance, a SECRET level government clearance, or having a higher-level clearance would expedite your start date on the contract, but we will also consider strong candidates interested in government service that can stay in place for 4-8 weeks while the clearance process finalizes. WE CAN ONLY ACCEPT U.S. CITIZENS and will verify personal information after the initial interview was successful to move forward.

So, what is the major modernization effort?

Older modernization roadmaps lacked long-term retirement strategies for core mainframes so IRS leadership rolled out a new technical framework stretching through 2029 with heavy emphasis on building a Unified API Layer to unlock legacy data. The IRS plans to wrap up its move toward a single, unified Enterprise Case Management (ECM) system. This platform will consolidate siloed databases and allow employees to support taxpayers from a single interface.

Fiscal Year 2028 Target : This is the projected completion window for updating the critical Individual Master File (IMF). The IMF has processed individual taxpayer data since 1970 using outdated COBOL and Assembly Language Code. The IRS aims to fully convert this core code into modern, developer-friendly Java.

By establishing a solid data structure and robust DevOps pipeline (using tools like SFDX and Git), the subcontractor we are hiring for helps create the stable infrastructure required for the IRS Office of Chief Counsel, the Taxpayer Advocate Service, and the Office of Appeals to safely adopt these modern AI systems.

Tech contests and other perks in addition to great HR benefits

The company is stable, growing, and has been around for 20 years.

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is looking for Software Engineers to join the Memory & Search team. We own how Claude remembers you and how it finds what it needs, across Claude.ai, Cowork and Claude Code. That spans the user-facing experience (what Claude remembers, how people see and edit it, how search surfaces the right conversation) and the shared infrastructure underneath it, the memory service, indexing, retrieval and vector search.

Memory is one of the biggest levers on whether Claude feels like it knows you. We recently moved memory from a periodically synthesized summary to a dynamic, editable, on-demand system, and then unified it so the same memory follows you across products. Search went from a top user complaint to something people rely on to find past work. The platform is now in place, and the next phase is finding the product form factors that make memory the most compelling and sticky part of using Claude.

That is why we are hiring product engineers. The team is strong on infrastructure, and we want people who have shipped user-facing products at scale, have a sharp sense for what makes a product feel good, and have built agentic systems where the model, the tools and the user interface have to work together. You will run short, demo-driven experiments on top of the memory and search stack, decide what to keep based on real usage, and help the whole team think like a product team. If you have founded a company, been an early engineer at a startup, or taken a product from zero to one, you will recognize the way we want to work.

This is a trust-sensitive surface. Memory touches privacy, consent and enterprise controls, so you will work closely with product, design, privacy, legal and safeguards, and you will be expected to treat those constraints as part of good product design rather than obstacles to it.

Key responsibilities

• Design, build and ship memory and search experiences in Claude.ai, Cowork and Claude Code, owning them end to end from the backend service through the model's tools to the user interface

• Run product experiments on the memory and search stack: form a hypothesis, build a demo, put it in front of real users, measure, and make a clear persevere-or-pivot call

• Shape how Claude uses memory and retrieval inside its agentic loop, including what the model stores, when it searches, how results are ranked and presented, and how the user stays in control

• Define and track the metrics that tell us whether memory is actually making Claude more useful, and build the evaluations that keep quality honest as the system evolves

• Improve search relevance and recall across conversations and memories, working across embeddings, hybrid retrieval and ranking as well as the interface that presents results

• Partner with product, design, privacy, legal and safeguards to ship features that respect user consent and enterprise requirements such as customer-managed encryption keys and data retention policies

• Raise the bar on product quality for the team through design reviews, code reviews and the standards you set for latency, polish and reliability
Share the on-call for the systems you own

Minimum qualifications

• Experience building and operating user-facing products used by a large number of people, including the backend services behind them

• Experience building agentic systems or LLM-powered products, including tool use, retrieval and prompt or context design

• Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across backend services and web front ends

• A track record of taking a product or feature from an idea to launch, and iterating on

title: AI Residency Program, Physical Sciences
description:
Your Impact at LILA

The Lila Sciences AI Residency is a full-time research program at the intersection of artificial intelligence and materials science. Residents join a cohort of researchers tackling open-ended scientific challenges alongside Lila's scientists and engineers, with the option to focus on fundamental or applied research.

Residencies run 6 to 12 months, with extension possible. First residencies begin in spring 2027, with rolling applications and additional intakes in fall 2027. Residents are paired with technical mentors, receive feedback from cross-functional teams, and work with proprietary datasets, high-performance compute, and Lila's research infrastructure. Publishing is encouraged but not required. What matters most is pushing the frontier of scientific discovery.

Priority research areas for the 2027 cohort span four domains:

• Soft matter and formulation intelligence: composition-process-property modeling, representation learning for mixtures and formulations, physics-informed and simulation-augmented predictive models, and generative models for 3D soft-material structures at the mesoscale and microscale (colloidal assemblies, phase-separated domains, particle networks, film and bulk morphologies)

• Physics-based simulation and in silico discovery: agentic frameworks for physics-based and multiphysics or multiscale simulations, and methods that orchestrate and bridge across simulation scales

• Chemistry-aware AI and molecular design: molecular representations (graphs, protein-ligand structures, MD trajectories), chemistry-reasoning agents, predictive models for synthesis, analysis, and purification, and experimental decision-making under uncertainty and operational constraints

• Foundational AI for materials science: sequential decision-making under real-world constraints, multimodal learning, reasoning and benchmarking, generative models and representation learning, and scientific machine learning

Applications require a resume and a research proposal of up to three pages (unlimited references) outlining the project you would pursue during your residency. Submit the research proposal as your cover letter. Applications without both documents will not be considered. Optional supporting materials such as recommendation letters, publications, or research artifacts are welcome.

What You'll Be Building

• Design and execute independent research projects in AI for materials science

• Pursue work in one or more of the 2027 priority research areas

• Collaborate with Lila scientists and engineers on open-science initiatives

• Co-develop novel approaches to scientific discovery with the wider team

• Use Lila's datasets, compute, and infrastructure to test ambitious hypotheses

• Share findings internally and externally; publication is welcome, not mandatory

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Degree in materials science, chemistry, computer science, AI/ML, physics, mathematics, or a related field (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD)

• Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch

• Experience working with large-scale datasets or simulations

• Familiarity with modern AI/ML architectures and training techniques

• Strong research background shown through publications, thesis work, or open-source projects

Bonus Points For

• Prior ML work in scientific domains such as materials discovery, chemistry, or simulation

• Experience in one or more of the 2027 priority research areas

• Open-source contributions or collaborative research experience

• Clear writing and communication on complex scientific ideas

title: Software Engineer, IP Infrastructure
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The IP Infrastructure team builds and operates the systems that enable OpenAI to share research and engineering technology securely and reliably with strategic partners. Our work spans continuously running pipelines for model weights, configurations, code, and container images.

We work closely with research, security, developer infrastructure, and partner engineering teams to turn complex requirements into dependable software. We’re a small, collaborative team with direct ownership of systems that support important partnerships.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a software engineer to build and improve the backend services behind these workflows. You’ll work primarily in Python, take projects from design through production, and make our systems more reliable and easier to operate as partner integrations evolve.

The work combines hands-on engineering with careful judgment. You’ll translate requirements about what can be shared into clear, testable business logic, debug problems across system boundaries, and collaborate with the teams that build and use the underlying infrastructure.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Build and maintain automated pipelines that transfer model weights, configurations, code, and container images between OpenAI and partner environments

- Implement the validation and business logic that determines how artifacts are prepared and shared

- Improve production reliability through testing, monitoring, useful diagnostics, and robust failure handling

- Integrate services with source control, object storage, and build and container tooling, working closely with the owners of shared infrastructure

- Partner with researchers, security teams, and external engineers to understand requirements and resolve integration problems

- Improve existing workflows and use AI tools where they can make the systems we build more effective

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have strong Python skills and experience building, testing, and debugging backend software

- Have taken a service, pipeline, or automation project from implementation into production and helped keep it reliable

- Enjoy investigating how systems fit together and tracing problems across services and dependencies

- Can turn ambiguous requirements into practical software while exercising sound judgment around sensitive information

- Communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical collaborators and enjoy working with partner engineering teams

- Learn unfamiliar systems quickly and take responsibility for following problems through to resolution

- Experience with cloud services, object storage, containers, or CI/CD is helpful. Our work involves tools such as Docker, Bazel, and Buildkite, but prior expertise in every tool or a particular cloud provider is not required.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Langfuse - Senior Cloud Infra Engineer
description:
WHY CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE AT LANGFUSE

Your work will keep Langfuse running - everywhere.

Langfuse processes over a billion trace events per month. When a Fortune 50 company relies on Langfuse in production, they're relying on the infrastructure you operate. You'll own uptime, performance, and cost efficiency across our entire cloud footprint - and you'll make sure every self-hosted deployment runs just as smoothly.

You'll operate Langfuse Cloud on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud, with Datadog as the observability backbone. You'll also own our public self-hosted infrastructure - including our Helm chart, Docker Compose setup, and everything in between - so that teams from startups to enterprises can run Langfuse on their own terms.

This isn't a "maintain what exists" role. We're scaling fast, and you'll be the person who makes sure the infrastructure grows ahead of demand - not behind it.

Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the team behind the database at the core of our stack is one channel away. Few infrastructure roles give you that kind of direct access to the people who build your most critical dependency.

 

YOU WILL GROW AT LANGFUSE BY

Own Langfuse Cloud operations: You'll run our production environments on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud. You'll manage deployments, autoscaling, capacity planning, and cost optimization - making sure we stay fast and affordable as traffic scales.

Build world-class observability: You'll own our Datadog setup end to end - dashboards, alerts, and SLOs. When something degrades, you'll ensure we know before our customers do. You'll build the monitoring culture that lets the whole team ship with confidence.

Make self-hosting effortless: Thousands of teams run Langfuse on their own infrastructure. You'll own and evolve our Helm chart, Docker Compose configuration, and deployment documentation. You'll turn "works on my machine" into "works on every machine" - from a single-node setup to a multi-region enterprise deployment.

Automate everything: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, automated scaling, zero-downtime deployments. You'll replace manual processes with automation that makes the team faster and the platform more reliable.

Scale for what's next: We're growing fast and new product directions - like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation - push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale and building the foundation before we get there. 10x is always just one quarter away here at Langfuse.

Harden security and compliance: As more enterprises adopt Langfuse, you'll help ensure our cloud and self-hosted deployments meet the security and compliance bar that large organizations require.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong infrastructure or SRE engineer who gets excited about running systems at scale and making them better every day

- Experience operating production workloads on AWS (ECS/Fargate, networking, IAM, S3, etc.) or on comparable hyperscale vendors.

- Comfortable with container orchestration - Kubernetes and/or ECS, Helm charts, Docker

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or similar)

- Strong monitoring and observability instincts - you've built dashboards and alerts that actually caught problems (Datadog experience is a plus)

- You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about reliability, automation, and how to ship infrastructure changes safely

- Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment helping users debug their self-hosted deployments

- Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

- CS or quantitative degree preferred

Bonus points:

- Experience with ClickHouse Cloud or other managed analytical databases

- Background in operating high-throughput event processing or observability infrastructure

- Contributions to open source infrastructure tooling (Helm charts, Terraform module

title: Rostering Coordinator (7X74WR45)
description:
Fully Remote - South Africa | Independent Contractor | Full-Time, UK office hours | A UK domiciliary care provider
About the Role
Outsource Ability is recruiting on behalf of a UK domiciliary care provider for an experienced and organised Rostering Coordinator. The provider delivers approximately 2,000 hours of home care each week across around 90 care staff.
You will plan, maintain and adjust care workers' schedules so that client visits are covered consistently, staff availability is used effectively and travel between visits is practical. This is not a data-entry role. It requires independent judgement and active problem-solving across a two-week rolling rota.
This role covers rostering only. You will not change assessed care needs, reduce agreed care durations or decide that a required visit can be missed. Unresolved staffing and care-delivery risks must be escalated to the designated line manager.
Key Responsibilities

• Maintain the two-week rolling rota, keeping regular clients with the same care worker wherever practical.

• Complete the following week's rota each Monday to Tuesday, recording leave, sickness and visit changes accurately.

• Monitor and resolve uncovered visits, which can exceed 100 during busy periods, by reorganising runs and contacting staff for additional availability.

• Use bank staff and pickup arrangements for short-term and weekend cover rather than permanent runs.

• Plan runs using full client postcodes, allowing practical travel time between visits.

• Allocate work within each care worker's availability and contracted hours, avoiding over-allocation or double-booking.

• Assess new care packages against geography, visit times and staff capacity, working to the Wednesday cut-off for Monday starts.

• Keep the rostering system accurate and handle client and staff information confidentially.

• Escalate uncovered visits and operational risks to the designated line manager, with a summary of action taken.

Systems

• CareFree (or a similar care-scheduling platform)
Experience with every system is not essential, but you must be confident learning new technology.
What We're Looking For
Essential

• Demonstrable experience coordinating high-volume schedules, staff rotas, dispatch or comparable logistics work.

• Ability to solve multi-step scheduling problems and see how one change affects other visits, staff and routes.

• Excellent accuracy and numerical confidence when tracking staff hours, gaps and deadlines.

• Clear written and spoken English, with confidence contacting staff and updating UK colleagues remotely.

• Sound decision-making under pressure, with the judgement to escalate an unresolved visit promptly.

• Confident use of scheduling software.

• Ability to work securely with confidential information.

Advantageous

• Experience in domiciliary care, healthcare or another time-critical visiting service.

• Experience using CareFree or a similar care-scheduling platform.

• Familiarity with UK postcodes, local route planning and two-week repeating rota patterns.

Remote Work Requirements
Applicants must:

• Be based in South Africa.

• Have a modern laptop or PC with an Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 processor or equivalent and a minimum of 8GB RAM.

• Have a stable fibre connection with a minimum of 50 Mbps download and 50 Mbps upload.

• Have a functional UPS, inverter or power station able to run the router and laptop for a minimum of 2-4 hours during load shedding.

• Have a professional noise-cancelling headset with a clear microphone.

• Have a quiet workspace suitable for calls and video meetings.

• Be available for the agreed full-time hours during UK office times.

title: Sales Development Representative - Nordics
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

We’re looking for Sales Development Representative to join our team covering the Nordics region coverage includes Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland.

In this role, you'll help drive Pleo’s growth and be part of the team responsible for expanding our footprint in spend management solutions as we scale our cutting-edge SaaS platform.

 

What you’ll be doing

As a Sales Development Representative you will:

- Build a pipeline through cold calling, social and email outreach to senior finance leaders.

- Qualify potential deals before passing them to Account Executives.

- Nurture relationships with Prospects.

- Use best in class tools for creative prospecting.

- Enable others and share best practices to learn as a team.

- Work towards achieving daily and weekly revenue targets and key performance

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- Previous professional experience in a customer-facing or sales-related role (preferably sales, finance, consulting)

- Driven and ambitious individual looking to grow quickly in sales

- Proactive and ready to take on own initiatives to drive results

- Comfortable with cold calling & getting out of your comfort zone

- Thrive on sales targets and constantly seek new ways to go the extra mile where needed

- A team player who goes out of their way to help colleagues succeed

- Entrepreneurial and creative mindset, ready to learn and grow every day

- Thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and excited to grow alongside the company

- Fluent in English (company language) and Danish or Swedish (Essential)

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

- You’ll report to our SDR Manager Europe and work closely with our in region Account Executives, as well as our marketing and partnerships teams. Our team of 4 is highly collaborative and dedicated to business growth.

How you’ll develop in this role

- In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Lead initiatives to drive impact in expanding Pleo’s presence in the Benelux market.

- Grow your skills in sales and outbound strategies, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale its operations across Benelux.

- We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in sales.

Show me the benefits!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

Please submit your CV in English. As English is the primary working language, a minimum proficiency level of B2 is required.
About Daon

Daon is a global leader in digital identity fraud prevention and protection against AI-generated synthetic identities. For over 25 years, we have partnered with governments and leading enterprises to deliver secure, seamless identity experiences across financial services, telecommunications, healthcare, travel, and critical infrastructure.
Our TrustX platform enables organizations to orchestrate secure, scalable, cross-channel identity workflows - supporting identity verification, biometric authentication, and lifecycle management across complex environments. More than two billion identities worldwide have been safeguarded by Daon technology. Recognized as a leading provider by Gartner®, KuppingerCole, and Frost & Sullivan®, Daon is shaping the future of identity security.
Daon has been providing fraud‑prevention solutions to organisations across six continents for over two decades.
Come play a part in advancing the next generation of face liveness, matching, and anti‑fraud biometric technologies.
Role Overview
As part of a collaborative team of research and data scientists based in Europe, you will play a meaningful role in advancing Daon 's biometric solutions. Working closely with research and engineering colleagues, your primary focus will be on improving and developing new biometric technologies that are delivered on time and aligned with our strategic objectives. You will report directly to the Principal Research Scientist.
What You'll Do
Working with the latest face biometric technologies, your responsibilities will include:

• Developing machine learning algorithms for face authentication solutions

• Researching, prototyping, and evaluating presentation attack detection and fraud prevention methods

• Testing and configuring face algorithms to meet performance and accuracy standards

• Extending and utilising existing biometric code libraries

• Running rigorous experiments, interpreting findings, and translating outcomes into deployable models and policies

• Helping to innovate and develop solutions to emerging face biometrics challenges

• Applying and continuously growing your expertise in AI, machine learning, and computer vision

What you have:
Hands on experience in at least two of the areas listed below.
A proven track record through project delivery, research contributions, or a minimum of two years of relevant employment experience:
(1) Computer Vision & Deep Learning

• Strong grounding in computer vision and machine learning principles

• Proficiency with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow

• Solid understanding of detection, recognition, and classical CV pipelines

• Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++, including version control, testing, and debugging

(2) Data & Experimental Methods

• Experience handling, preprocessing, and analysing large-scale datasets

• Familiarity with synthetic data generation or weakly/lightly supervised learning approaches

(3) Image Recognition & Matching

• Experience with authentication, identity matching, or metric learning

• Knowledge of feature extraction, alignment, and embedding-based systems

(4) Liveness & Anti-Spoofing

• Exposure to presentation attack detection, including replay, mask, or deepfake scenarios

• Interest or experience in adversarial robustness and anti-spoofing research

Nice to have:

• Ability to review, interpret, and implement state-of-the-art research

• Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate workflow and productivity

• Awareness of privacy, ethics, and security considerations in biometrics

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Education
Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineerin

United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

Co-founded in 2023 by Joe Laws and Grant Verstandig, Trase Systems is AI, Uncomplicated. Trase empowers enterprise leaders to harness the full potential of AI without the associated complexity and risks. We are an end-to-end solution for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI in the enterprise. Our platform specializes in bridging the “last mile” of AI adoption, unlocking AI's full potential while driving efficiency and significant cost savings.Trase is at the forefront of AI Agent innovation, topping the Hugging Face GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, ahead of industry giants such as Google, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI. We are leveraging our cutting-edge technologies to develop mission-critical agentic applications in complex industries such as Healthcare, Oil & Gas, and National Security.
About the Role
As a Senior or Staff DevOps Engineer at Trase, you will build, deploy, and operate the infrastructure supporting Red Cell Federal and Red Cell Partners ’ incubations and portfolio companies. You will join Trase's dedicated RCF/RCP support team, with a strong focus on federal, government, and national security programs.
Red Cell Partners is an investment and incubation firm that builds and supports technology companies, including Trase. Red Cell Federal is our federal-focused partner within that ecosystem. This role helps RCF and other RCP partner companies adopt and operate Trase OS in their own environments.
This is a hands-on engineering role spanning partner onboarding, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, secure releases, observability, and production support. You will work directly with partner engineers, Trase's dedicated software engineers and TPM, Platform Engineering, and GRC to turn requirements into validated deployments and dependable operations.
The level will reflect the candidate's experience and demonstrated scope. Senior engineers will independently deliver and support complex partner deployments. Staff engineers will also lead architecture across partner environments, establish reusable standards, and mentor engineers.
Why this Role is Needed
RCF and RCP companies need secure, repeatable deployments across commercial and government cloud, private networks, and on-premises infrastructure. Their requirements span installation, integrations, hardening, upgrades, incident response, and ongoing vulnerability remediation.
This role provides dedicated engineering ownership from environment readiness through sustained operations. You will make deployments easier to install, validate, upgrade, and support, while turning recurring partner needs into reusable capabilities with Trase's platform team.
What You'll Do

• Build and operate RCF/RCP partner environments across AWS, Azure, GCP, and customer-controlled or on-premises infrastructure, adapting to each program's access, networking, and security requirements.

• Package and validate Trase OS services and dependencies using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and approved registries. Maintain complete, versioned image inventories, release manifests, and image digests so partner deliveries contain the required artifacts.

• Create reusable infrastructure-as-code modules, cluster bootstrap automation, and CI/CD or GitOps workflows using Terraform, Pulumi, Argo CD, or comparable tools.

• Prepare and validate networking, IAM, secrets, certificates, storage, registries, and model-provider connectivity. Support restricted-network and disconnected deployment patterns where required, in partnership with application engineers.
